mechanism_narrative: A higher-than-trend FEDFUNDS rate at month-end precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to expectations of tighter policy later in the quarter.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a control period with similar FEDFUNDS levels (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (labor market strength) coincides with positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as strong hiring signals robust consumer demand.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, returns are negative despite PAYEMS above average (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production) below its 12-month average predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns due to supply-side contraction.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when INDPRO is below average (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising HOUST (retail sales) with a 2-month moving average crossing above 1100 suggests accelerating demand, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive when HOUST_2mo_avg crosses above 1100 (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained double-digit drop in UNRATE (unemployment) over two consecutive months triggers a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as lower labor costs boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite UNRATE falling for two months (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their 12-month averages for three consecutive months predict positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns via dual demand channels.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > GDPC1_12mo_avg AND RSAFS > RSAFS_12mo_avg AND both for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive when both proxies are above average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in PAYEMS (job creation) below the prior quarter's average coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak labor demand weighs on equities.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when PAYEMS falls below prior quarter average (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged monthly decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 2% suggests central bank patience, resulting in a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as expectations of lower rate hikes improve equity valuations.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive when CPIAUCSL is above 2% (p < 0.05).
